detached_structure.evidence: A gray-roofed rectangular structure sits at the rear (south) edge of the outlined lot, next to the patio. It could be a rear extension or a detached outbuilding.

signals.notes: The lot is long and narrow, with a gray-shingled house, one white vehicle on the front driveway, a rear patio with umbrellas and seating, a fenced lawn, and a large tree canopy at the north front of the lot.
